newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Vilnius Bank hits new high on Lithuanian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Vilnius Bank hits new high on Lithuanian bourse.

text.p: Shares in leading bank Vilnius Bank hit a new high on the Lithuanian stock exchange on Thursday, leading other key shares up, dealers said.
The bank's shares rose to 1,310 litas from 1,300 in a deal worth 131,000 litas.

Brokerage firm Suprema said its in-house index of shares rose to 1,111 from 1,101. Brokers said shares were continuing to pick up steam as investors were switching from debt to equity as government Treasury bill yields fall.
The Birzhu dairy shares also rose, hitting 4.49 litas after 4.10 and 1,970 of its stock changed hands.

The Medienos Plausis cardboard manufacturer was stable at 10.50 litas as 2,292 of its shares changed hands while the Kalnapilis brewery stock dipped to 8.50 litas from 8.60 litas on turnover of 1,619 shares.
